description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCacheFactory class, responsible for creating and managing definition cache objects in the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for setup, singleton instance retrieval, cache registration, creation, and decorator addition.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCacheFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing definition cache objects, applying decorators, and maintaining cache configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes default decorators for the cache factory.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the cache factory, optionally replacing it with a provided prototype.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new cache implementation by short and long name.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a cache object based on configuration and manages cache decorator application.

methods.name: addDecorator
methods.description: Adds a decorator to all subsequent cache objects.
